risk: Runtime tests still required; this review does not claim cross-platform execution.
review: Existing root resolution and host-bound profile checks refuse legacy/rebound paths; ordinary connection construction is shared.
Physical reads use native contained non-probing policies, revalidate traversal, require private existing Unix permissions, and never chmod or create data directories.
The atomic-write match is FileMode.Open/FileAccess.Read/FileShare.Read; it performs no writes.
Key enumeration is top-directory only, 128 files and 64 KiB per file; profile publication scans stop after 256 entries.
JSON property uniqueness matches web serializer case-insensitivity; case-insensitive pending-name detection is conservative refusal on every platform.
Data Protection shares existing platform/certificate configuration but disables key generation and uses a repository whose StoreElement always refuses.
